text:
Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the inspection check 
 list I1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
 block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Sawsan 
 El_Lethy, tested by eng Ashraf ayounes at 27 Aug. 2003, reversed by EDEPCo. 
 quality control eng. Abdel Menem AL Emam, and approved by eng. Mohamed Goda EL_Said 
 General 
 Director of Port Said G.T. Power Station, certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al-Lethy, EDEPCo. 
 Inspection and Quality Control Head Sector.
Safety Precautions
Work permit must be issued the 
 maintenance staff should be qualified and carry the suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear 
 the personal
 protective equipment as (safety shoes, Helmet).
Turbine must be shut down &
ensure that all MCC CB off (racked 
 out).
Tools and Equipment
Digital AVO. Meter
Frequency meter
Frequency meter
Speed tronic calibrator set model (151A4925)
Speed tronic calibrator set model (151A4925)
Special tool to adjust the variable resistance at the cards
Work to be Carried Out
Over Speed Test
Connect calibrator set cables to the connection A, B on the 
speedtronic page.
Pull card SFPB at 1L
Press and hold push button at front 
 of card SSZB to make the speed control off .
Increase speed until speed control just comes ON using calibrator set lamb on 
 the card.
Ensure the speed = 5620 r.p.m 
 (110 % NHP)
If it not correct the card 
 must be changed.
Repeat steps from 1 to 5 for channels 2, 3
Return Cards into Service
Remove all Jumpers
Remove the calibrator set
Put cards in normal position
Remove all Jumpers
Remove the calibrator set
Put cards in normal position
